name: Forum
notes: Seat of the governor and the town council. Already there.

name: Harbour
notes: DRAFT (v11). Two years to build. Berths for 6 ships: merchant galleys and triremes together, keels on the slipway included.

name: Walls and towers
notes: DRAFT. +2 to every battle fought at home (not on a march). The walls are the ring round the town and take no plot inside it; a second build raises more towers (+2 again).

name: Weavers' workshop
notes: DRAFT. Turns 3 fleece into 3 cloth every season.

name: Trading district
notes: DRAFT. Stall fees +100 denarii a season; convoys trade 10% better.

name: Temple
notes: DRAFT. Three years to build. +1 loyalty and +1 Roman favour every season.

name: Barracks
notes: DRAFT. Soldiers cost 1 denarius less; +1 to battle rolls.

name: Baths
notes: DRAFT. Two years to build. +2 loyalty every season.

name: Wheat terraces
notes: DRAFT. Big terraces: each counts as two of the old ones. First harvest after two seasons. The 2 at the start give the 8 months a year in seasons.csv.

name: Vineyard
notes: DRAFT. A big vineyard. First vintage a year after planting, full after two. 24 amphorae each Autumn.

name: Olive grove
notes: DRAFT. Grafted trees: first oil after two years, full after three. 10 amphorae each Winter.

name: Sheep pasture
notes: DRAFT. 8 bales of fleece at the Spring shearing.

name: Fishery
notes: DRAFT. +0.5 months of food every season; with salt, 2 jars of salted fish.

name: Salt pans
notes: DRAFT. Sea water dries in the summer sun: 10 sacks.

name: Woodcutters' camp
notes: DRAFT. 4 loads of timber a season once the paths are cut.

name: Iron mine
notes: DRAFT. 3 bars of iron a season. Two shafts at most.

name: Citadel on the hill
notes: DRAFT. A fortress on the crag above the town, joined to the walls. +5 when the enemy storms the town. Two years to build (v11: cheaper, 20 timber and 6 iron). Click the dashed citadel site on the crag in the orders phase.

name: Sanctuary of Cadmus and Harmonia
notes: DRAFT (v12). A wonder of the Adriatic for the serpent-founders of Illyria. Needs the temple first. Three years to build. When it is finished the coast hails you as a living god: a religious victory.
